name: Hana
source:
LIKES: Drawing manga
DISLIKES: Heights

Hana is a wise teacher, ready to impart, her knowledge of Japanese on to you! She'll accompany you on your adventure and she's always ready to answer your questions.

As a girl, she dreamt of becoming a famous manga artist. Drawing is her main hobby and she's incredibly passionate about it.

Hana was born and raised in Kyoto, Japan. When she graduated university, she moved to various cities around the country, never really calling any place home.

When you meet, she introduces herself as your Japanese teacher - your sensei! Hana's kind and patient attitude puts you at ease when you attend lessons.

Though she's a remarkable teacher, Hana's true passion lies within her hobby of drawing. She often leaves sketches lying around that demonstrate her talents. However, she never professionally pursued her artistic calling, and you can't help but wonder why.
